Two sentences now decide: "A `%User{}` built from the params and passed to `Repo.insert/1` or `Repo.update/1` is the pattern to replace: Ecto writes the struct as given, so nothing is validated and a constraint violation raises." and "Declare database constraints in the changeset (`unique_constraint/3`, and `foreign_key_constraint/3` or `assoc_constraint/3` for a `belongs_to`) so a violation returns `{:error, changeset}` instead of raising." The previous sweep already accepted assoc_constraint(:user) (skill-opus-1), so the change moves no verdict here.

In the previous sweep 1 of the 4 haiku and sonnet skill runs (skill-haiku-2) left the constraint out.

The grade file's format_ok comes from Code.format_string!/2 with those DSL calls in locals_without_parens, as the previous sweep computed it; all four pass. Nothing compiles because Phoenix and Ecto are not installed.
